owner: original portal connector runtime / Netlify protected release
root_cause: Production edge-traffic for 9–10 Nov 2026 independently reported 404 on /api/connectors while the canonical portal frontend's GET list and POST draft actions call exactly /api/connectors. Original Netlify connector function registered ONLY /api/connectors/* (wildcard), which does not guarantee the bare root URLPattern. The runtime handler already correctly supports root GET and POST behind the same tenant-authenticated Netlify Identity getUser() gate. This is a missing entrypoint registration, not missing provider data.
fix: Reuse exact existing authenticated tenant connector function with Netlify-supported custom path array ['/api/connectors','/api/connectors/*']; preserve separate public readiness exclusion and existing tenant identity, suppression, data-sovereignty and safe-test gates. Strengthen existing negative route isolation regressions. No second API handler, SDK or datastore.
prevention: Every public portal API root URL invoked from a UI must have a concrete Netlify route registration; include exact-root plus child and readiness-negative tests, protected Netlify deployment and live unauthenticated 401 (never 404/200) readback before marking route live.
terminal_rule: Only protected exact-head Required + CodeQL + Netlify deploy corresponding exact commit + public unauthorized GET /api/connectors returns 401 from same function + authenticated tenant A/B listing and draft readback can close the connector root route. Real provider-synced data is a separate obligation.
